t_advice_summary_textbox.text: In each round you are presented with a pair of gnomes. They are usually the same colour pairings for example green and orange or red and blue. You have to eventually figure out which colour in that pairing gives you better results and a higher score. But the colour and pair could change at any time so you have to adjust and figure out again which is the best option.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes will appear on the screen in pairs. The two gnomes will be different colours. There are multiple pairs but they will always be the same two colours. When you choose one of the coloured gnomes, you need to evaluate if that colour gets you the most points. Once you've figured out that the colour yields a good result, stick with it. Sometimes it switches up and that colour is no longer the one that brings you the highest points. So be prepared to re-evaluate the colour you choose sometimes in the game.
